DATA USE AGREEMENT FOR A LIMITED DATA SET

This Data Use Agreement is between Ridgeview Health System ("Covered Entity") and Calloway University ("Recipient").

1. Limited Data Set. Covered Entity will disclose to Recipient a limited data set, as defined in 45 C.F.R. 164.514(e), for the research study described in Exhibit A.

2. Permitted Uses. Recipient may use the limited data set only for the research purpose and as required by law.

3. Safeguards. Recipient will use appropriate safeguards to prevent use or disclosure of the limited data set other than as this Agreement provides.

4. Reporting. Recipient will report to Covered Entity any use or disclosure not provided for by this Agreement of which it becomes aware.
